purpose: Teach: 口語/前衛/性欲/優勢/伯爵/健常/皇位/綱領

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、日本語の口語表現の歴史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on the history of colloquial expressions in Japanese, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Slight upward inflection on the question, inviting confirmation rather than testing. Steady and observant, the tone of a teacher who's actually read the work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、前衛芸術の評価史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I focused on the history of how avant-garde art has been evaluated.
lines.style: Quiet but direct. A slight pause before the correction, not defensive but precise. Respectful, the careful tone of someone clarifying a misunderstanding to someone whose opinion matters.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、青年期の性欲と社会化の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper examined adolescent sexuality and socialization, didn't it?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly probing. A gentle pause before the subject, gauging his comfort. Steady eye contact level. The measured tone of someone raising a delicate topic with respect.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、選挙で優勢に立った候補者の戦略を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—actually, I wrote on the strategies of candidates who gained momentum in elections.
lines.style: Quiet correction again, but with a thread of confidence this time. Not impatient, but clearer. The correction carries a small understatement—he knows what he wrote.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 英国貴族の伯爵家の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You explored the history of English aristocratic earldoms in your research, correct?
lines.style: Engaged, slightly more curious than before. The question carries genuine interest—she's noticing a pattern. Clear articulation, no condescension. Leaning in slightly with attention.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、健常児童と発達障害の比較研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I actually did a comparative study of children without developmental disabilities and those with them.
lines.style: Patient but with a very slight edge of dry humor underneath. The corrections have accumulated; he's still measured but there's a thread of 'you're testing me' acknowledgment. Quiet laugh in the back of the throat waiting.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、皇位継承の歴史比較を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper was on the historical comparison of imperial succession, wasn't it?
lines.style: Reflective, almost gently. She's realized what's happening now. Less a question, more an observation—slightly amused, slightly impressed. Warm undertone, like she's in on the pattern too.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、政党綱領の比較研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I actually examined comparative research on political party platforms.
lines.style: Final correction, delivered with quiet finality and a faint, genuine smile underneath. The last earnest affirmation—he's been patient, he's been right each time, and he knows she knows now. Small fade at the very end.
